description: The five television movies lead into Hercules’ first regular adventures, establishing his conflict with Hera, his partnership with Iolaus and his encounters with Xena before her path changes.

s01e01-02.description: Hercules and Iolaus take time out from Iolaus' wedding preparations to help a distant village under attack from "monsters," who are in fact Amazonian women controlled by Hera.

s01e03-04.description: Hercules rescues a princess from being sacrificed and they search for a missing city.

s01e05-06.description: Hercules and Deianeira set out to find fire to save the world from cold.

s01e07-08.description: Hercules is accidentally poisoned by his wife and must find a way out of the underworld.

s01e09-10.description: Hercules, settled down with his wife and children, is persuaded out of retirement to help a distant village which is being attacked by an unseen monster.

s01e11.description: When his stepmother Hera destroys his family, Hercules is so consumed by hatred that he loses sight of his purpose to help people in need.

s01e12.description: Hercules discovers the real reason why a giant Cyclops has been terrorizing a village.

s01e13.description: Hercules accompanies a town's citizens, cursed by Hera because of a theft at her temple, on a perilous journey to a city offering safe haven.

s01e14.description: Hercules uncovers an elaborate plot calling for the murder of a king during a celebration honoring the god of wine.

s01e15.description: Hercules confronts his half brother Ares, the god of war, in his attempt to prevent a teen-age boy from becoming one of the evil deity's soldiers.

s01e16.description: Hercules attends a friend's wedding where Nemis the Centaur arrives and abducts the bride and her maid of honor.

s01e17.description: Hercules' friend Iolaus fights for his life when Hera decides to punish him for an act of pride.

s01e18.description: Hercules rescues a woman from slavery and then must help to free her fiancee from the slavers.

s01e19.description: The perfect woman is waiting for Iolaus. Unfortunately, she's an evil, power-hungry warrior princess, who's using him to get Hercules out of the way.

s01e20.description: Hercules and Iolaus fight to free the slaves forced to battle to the death in a gladiatorial arena.

s01e21.description: A civil war pits brother against sister, and someone-or some nasty god-is stealing the bodies of their dead soldiers.

s01e22.description: Warrior princess Xena joins forces with Hercules when her troops turn on her under the command of the cruel and ruthless Darphus.

s01e23.description: While working together to stop the marauding Darphus, Hercules and the warrior princess Xena take their personal relationship to a new level.
